plugins.name: 5Stack Inventory
plugins.author: lukepolo
plugins.description: A loadout editor that renders natively inside the panel. Pairs with the CS2 Inventory Simulator game plugin, which puts those loadouts in players' hands.

plugins.name: Arenas
plugins.author: shmitzas
plugins.description: Ladder-based 1v1 and small-team arenas: players climb and fall through ranked arenas between rounds, with configurable weapon sets. A bug-fix fork of K4ryuu's K4-Arenas.
plugins.requires_service: A database (SQLite ships by default; MySQL and Postgres are supported)

plugins.name: CSRoll
plugins.author: LCrew
plugins.description: Chaos-mod style game modifiers. Players or admins roll gameplay-altering effects — jetpack, wallhack, speedhack, vampire, infinite ammo and ~40 more — scoped to a round, a run of rounds, or the whole match, server-wide or per player.

plugins.name: Deathmatch
plugins.author: ianlucas
plugins.description: Free-for-all deathmatch with random spawns, timed weapon-mode rotation (pistols, mid-tier, rifles), health and armor back on kills, gun commands and bot loadouts.

config_schema.title: Weapon rotation
config_schema.description: Each mode runs for its duration, then the next one starts. Players can only pick the weapons their mode allows.

plugins.name: EA Adverts
plugins.author: EsportAdria
plugins.description: Timed server messages in chat, center HUD, center HTML or alert. Groups with their own interval, order, team or alive/dead targeting and permission skip, edited in the panel. Also sends one-off announcements over RCON.

Prefix.title: Chat prefix
Prefix.description: Put in front of chat messages. Leave empty for none.

ServerName.title: Server name
ServerName.description: Shown for {server_name}. Set it per server: 5stack doesn't set the hostname, so empty shows Counter-Strike 2.

TimeZone.title: Time zone
TimeZone.description: IANA name for {time} and {date}, for example Europe/Zagreb. Empty uses the server's clock.

Groups.title: Groups
Groups.description: Each group runs on its own timer. Placeholders: {server_name}, {map}, {player_count}, {max_players}, {time}, {date}. Colours (chat and center_html; center and alert drop them): [default], [white], [red], [lightred], [darkred], [green], [lime], [olive], [blue], [lightblue], [darkblue], [bluegrey], [purple], [lightpurple], [magenta], [yellow], [lightyellow], [gold], [orange], [grey], [silver].

DisplayType.title: Display
DisplayType.description: On deathmatch servers the DM plugin's timer overwrites center messages every second. Use chat or center_html there.

SkipPermissions.title: Skip for permissions
SkipPermissions.description: Players with any of these SwiftlyS2 permissions don't see this group, for example vip.ads.skip.

plugins.name: CS2 Inventory Simulator
plugins.author: ianlucas
plugins.description: Gives players their skins, knives, gloves, agents, music kits and sprays from a web-hosted inventory, with StatTrak tracking and live refresh.
plugins.requires_service: An Inventory Simulator API (the 5Stack Inventory plugin serves one)

plugins.name: MapChooser
plugins.author: aga
plugins.description: Map voting for community servers: rock the vote, nominations, end-of-map votes, extends and an automatic map cycle. Workshop maps by ID. Runs the map rotation set on a dedicated server.

plugins.name: Retakes
plugins.author: aga
plugins.description: Bombsite retakes with auto-plant, instant defuse, per-map spawns and smoke scenarios, round-type weapon and utility allocation, queueing and an in-game spawn editor. Loadout preferences persist when the Cookies plugin is installed.
